title: Server Side Rendering
content:
Server Side Rendering (SSR) is a technique where the server generates the complete HTML of a web page for each request, and sends this HTML to the client. This allows the web page to be viewable and functional even before any JavaScript is loaded and executed on the client-side. It can improve the initial load time and SEO of web applications.
Benefits of SSR
Improved SEO: Since the full HTML is available immediately, search engines can crawl the content more effectively.
Faster First Paint: The browser can start rendering the HTML while the JavaScript is still being loaded, leading to a faster perceived load time.
Better Performance on Slow Connections: Users on slow networks can see content sooner since they don't have to wait for JavaScript to load and execute.
